title: landsat-thermal-edge-analysis: code for edge-associated thermal patterns in Landsat surface temperature (Paraná, Brazil)
description: Processing and analysis code for the article Edge-associated thermal patterns in Landsat surface temperature: magnitude, transition depth and directional contrasts across land-cover classes in Paraná, southern Brazil (Remote Sensing Applications: Society and Environment). The code builds the scene × polygon × neighbouring class × distance-ring database from public inputs (Landsat Collection 2 Level 2, MapBiomas Collection 10.1, ERA5-Land, SRTM) and computes the edge thermal difference (DET), the thermal transition depth (DEP) and the directional thermal edge contrast (DTEC) with crossed polygon × scene and spatial-block bootstrap uncertainty.
